description:
Create a directory; missing parents are created unless create_dirs=0.
Use when: you need an empty directory. For a file use project_write_file, which also creates parent folders.
Avoid when: you write file content (project_write_file) or edit existing content (project_edit_file).
Output: directory_created {relative_path, created, parents_created}.

create_dirs.description: 1 creates missing parent directories (default 1); 0 fails when a parent is missing.

reason.description: Optional why (max 400 chars), audit-logged. Required only on project_ci_control.

relative_path.description: Workspace-relative ('.' = root); absolute/.. outside it rejected.
